questions.prompt: What contrast does Phil establish between the summit agreement and subsequent research?

options.label: A
options.text: The summit predicted when all warming would end, but researchers changed that date.

options.label: B
options.text: The summit set a target for June weather, while researchers considered only winter.

options.label: C
options.text: Later findings indicate warming beyond the limit the summit had agreed to pursue.

options.label: D

questions.prompt: Which interpretation best reflects Kate's distinction between predictions and projections?

options.label: A
options.text: A projection describes an outcome that depends on specified conditions or actions.

options.label: B
options.text: A projection establishes in advance which decisions people will make.

options.label: C
options.text: A prediction is necessarily more reliable than any computer-based projection.

options.label: D
options.text: A projection is restricted to explaining changes that have already happened.

questions.prompt: Why would it be misleading to summarise Kate's explanation as "clouds only cool the Earth"?
